components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The dark, compact action used for sign-in and primary contained actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 2.8rem; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: .65rem 1rem; border: 1px solid var(--ink); border-radius: .4rem; color: #fff; background: var(--ink); cursor: pointer; font: 800 .85rem/1.35 ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { border-color: var(--green); background: var(--green); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A quiet bordered action for maintenance, restoration, and cancellation.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { min-height: 2.8rem; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: .65rem 1rem; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: .4rem; color: var(--ink); background: var(--panel); cursor: pointer; font: 800 .85rem/1.35 ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { color: #fff; border-color: var(--ink); background: var(--ink); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Danger Button
components.description: A fault-red confirmed action for destructive operations.
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { min-height: 2.8rem; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: .65rem 1rem; border: 1px solid var(--red); border-radius: .4rem; color: #fff; background: var(--red); cursor: pointer; font: 800 .85rem/1.35 ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-btn-danger:hover { filter: brightness(.92); } .ds-btn-danger:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-danger:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: The white, fine-rule field used for credentials and typed confirmations.
components.css: .ds-field-label { display: block; margin-bottom: .55rem; color: var(--ink); font: 700 .85rem/1.35 ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-field { width: 100%; min-height: 3rem; padding: .75rem .85rem; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: .45rem; color: var(--ink); background: var(--panel); caret-color: var(--green); font: 1rem/1.55 ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-field:hover { border-color: var(--muted); } .ds-field:focus { border-color: var(--focus); } .ds-field:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Status Lamp
components.description: The circular state signal that summarizes recorder health without a badge.
components.css: .ds-status { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 1rem; color: var(--ink); font: 700 1rem/1.2 ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-status-lamp { width: .8rem; height: .8rem; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--green); box-shadow: 0 0 0 .4rem var(--green-soft); } .ds-status:focus-within { outline: 3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Power Control
components.description: The signature circular control for starting or stopping recording without powering off the Pi.
components.css: .ds-power { width: 12rem; min-height: 12rem; display: grid; place-items: center; align-content: center; gap: .65rem; padding: 1rem; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 50%; color: var(--ink); background: var(--panel); cursor: pointer; text-align: center; transition: transform .2s ease-out, background .2s ease-out, color .2s ease-out; font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-power svg { width: 2.4rem; height: 2.4rem; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.8; stroke-linecap: round; } .ds-power strong { font-weight: 850; } .ds-power small { max-width: 12ch; color: var(--muted); font-size: .72rem; line-height: 1.35; } .ds-power:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); color: #fff; background: var(--ink); } .ds-power:hover small { color: inherit; } .ds-power:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-power:active { transform: translateY(0); }

components.name: Warning Alert
components.description: A full-width amber plane reserved for actionable system warnings.
components.html: Storage reserveFree space is below 8 GiB. Run cleanup and move recordings off the microSD.
components.css: .ds-alert { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 9rem 1fr; gap: 1rem; padding: .85rem 1rem; color: #603506; background: var(--amber-soft); font: 1rem/1.45 ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-alert strong { font-size: .8rem; } .ds-alert:focus-within { outline: 3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Top Navigation
components.description: A quiet sticky header line joining identity, live status, and session exit.
components.html: CCTV ControlRecording on
components.css: .ds-nav { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr auto 1fr; align-items: center; min-height: 4rem; padding: .6rem 1.5rem; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); color: var(--ink); background: rgba(243,245,243,.96); font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-nav a { color: var(--ink); font-weight: 800; text-decoration: none; letter-spacing: -.015em; } .ds-nav-status { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: .5rem; font-size: .82rem; font-weight: 700; } .ds-nav-status i { width: .55rem; height: .55rem; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--green); } .ds-nav button { justify-self: end; min-height: 2.5rem; padding: .35rem 0; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid transparent; color: var(--ink); background: transparent; cursor: pointer; font-weight: 750; } .ds-nav a:hover, .ds-nav button:hover { border-bottom-color: currentColor; } .ds-nav a:focus-visible, .ds-nav button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 3px; }

narrative.overview:
CCTV Control behaves like a precise architectural faceplate: one unmistakable operating state, one tactile primary control, and supporting facts arranged with quiet discipline. The mood is calm, dependable, and utilitarian without becoming industrial theater. A matte cool-white field, charcoal type, fine rules, and compact native system typography keep the interface fast and credible on a resource-constrained device.

Healthy information recedes; recording state and actionable warnings surface immediately. Green communicates confirmed operation, while amber and red appear only when the system requires attention or an action is destructive. Flat planes and open spacing replace dashboard cards, gauges, decorative metaphor, and equal-weight controls.
keyCharacteristics: Matte cool-white field with crisp white controls
Circular status lamps and one circular primary control
Fine structural rules instead of card containers
Sparse, semantic green, amber, and red
Progressive disclosure for maintenance and diagnostics

rules.name: The Semantic Color Rule
rules.body: Green means confirmed operation, amber means attention or unknown, red means stopped, destructive, or failed, and blue means keyboard focus; never use them as decoration.

rules.name: The Quiet Health Rule
rules.body: Healthy diagnostics stay neutral except for small status indicators or values where confirmation is useful; warnings may claim a full-width tinted plane.

rules.name: The One Loud Sentence Rule
rules.body: Reserve display scale for the current recording state; no secondary metric competes at that size.

rules.name: The Plain Label Rule
rules.body: Use sentence case and direct language rather than all-caps commands, jargon, or metaphorical names.

rules.name: The Open Plane Rule
rules.body: Use spacing and rules to group content; do not introduce a dashboard wall of separate cards.

rules.name: The Flat-Until-Interrupted Rule
rules.body: Resting page surfaces have no shadow; only state lamps, modal dialogs, and transient toasts may lift or glow.

rules.name: The One Circle Rule
rules.body: Large circular geometry belongs to the primary recording control; supporting circles remain tiny status indicators.

dos: Do make recording state the clearest sentence and the recording power control the clearest action.
Do distinguish stopping CCTV from powering off the Raspberry Pi in adjacent plain language.
Do use fine rules, spacing, and disclosure to organize dense operational information.
Do preserve visible keyboard focus, semantic status announcements, mobile touch targets, and reduced-motion behavior.
Do keep destructive actions deliberate, fault-red, confirmed, and visibly recoverable through quarantine.
donts: Don't use semantic green, amber, red, or focus blue as decorative accent colors.
Don't turn diagnostics, recordings, or maintenance actions into an equal-weight grid of cards or gauges.
Don't add decorative CCTV imagery, gradients, glass effects, or ornamental metaphor.
Don't let maintenance and logs occupy the first view when the user has not requested them.
Don't animate continuously except for the bounded pending-state pulse, and suppress that pulse when reduced motion is requested.
